global_ingestion_rules: A web page marked open or a metadata license field is not by itself sufficient when the same record has contradictory or absent license information.
Do not download, check in, transform, redistribute or embed source data until access permissions, license scope, attribution obligations, modification rights and intended use are documented.
Dataset access and dataset reuse rights are separate questions. A downloadable file is not automatically licensed for reuse.
Do not promote metadata statements to observed data quality; inspect source artifact bytes, schema, data dictionary, station/time coverage, missingness, units and revisions before accepting a series.
Any later receipt must bind source artifact digest, exact indicator catalog digest, source revision, unit mapping and time/geography definitions.
A dataset may be appropriate for scholarly analysis but not for a public, commercial or redistributed product; qualification must be scoped to the actual intended use.

candidates.title: EO Africa SWAM satellite-derived water-quality series
candidates.publisher: Zenodo record; work by CSIR, University of Cape Town and University of Stirling
candidates.reported_availability: The record is marked Open and lists timeseries CSVs plus NetCDF cubes. The page's Rights/License section does not display an unambiguous file license.

temporal_coverage.basis: Sentinel-2 acquisition search period described in record; individual series ranges must be verified from files.

spatial_coverage.geography: Six named water bodies in southern Africa
spatial_coverage.caveat: The place-code names and exact polygons must be verified against source metadata; do not assume the Rietvlei record is the Rietvlei nearest Johannesburg without checking the coordinates.

reported_measures.name: Chlorophyll-a concentration
reported_measures.method_summary: The record describes ACOLITE-RAdCor atmospheric correction and an MDN algorithm.

reported_measures.name: Total suspended matter concentration
reported_measures.method_summary: The record describes C2RCC/C2X-Complex and the Jiang et al. 2023 algorithm.

reported_data_shape.quality_coverage_rule: Records are included only where more than 5% of total water-body area has valid pixels after atmospheric correction and the water-quality algorithm.
columns_reported: mean or median concentration depending on variable

preview_only_inspection.method: web text preview only; not a retained or locally hashed source artifact
preview_only_inspection.note: Preview dates are discovery observations only. Do not treat this as an ingested dataset or a verified complete time range.

license_assessment.assessment_note: The landing page does not clearly display the record's file license in its Rights section. Zenodo's policies say publicly available files should have a license. Verify the record's API metadata and deposited file-level rights, then retain the exact response. Do not infer CC0 or any other license from platform defaults.

required_evidence: Record-level file license confirmed from authoritative metadata or written rights-holder permission
Commercial/research redistribution and transformation rights confirmed for the intended product
Original file downloaded in an approved workspace and SHA-256 calculated
CSV schema, row counts, date range, missingness, duplicate timestamps and non-finite values inspected
Water-body coordinates/polygons and site identity checked against the record
Algorithm, atmospheric correction, valid-pixel threshold and remote-sensing uncertainty recorded
Reconcile the record description's stated search end date (2025-08-30) with the CHL CSV preview's last displayed date (2025-11-07) and document the authoritative data/version window
Verify the exact Rietvlei water-body coordinates and confirm the target site identity before any Johannesburg-area association

suitability.best_initial_use: A narrow, clearly labeled remote-sensing water-quality evidence pilot after rights and location checks.
suitability.not_suitable_for: Treating satellite-derived concentrations as laboratory samples, direct drinking-water safety certification, or causal proof that an intervention improved water quality.
suitability.next_action: Resolve file-level license using record metadata/API or authors' written confirmation. If rights are suitable, inspect one CSV time series before considering the larger NetCDF cube.

known_findings.observation: Zenodo record description states the Sentinel-2 search period was 2015-08-01 through 2025-08-30, while the publicly rendered CHL_timeseries_2015_2025_CW.csv preview contains a row dated 2025-11-07. The discrepancy may reflect stale narrative metadata, later processing, or a different range; the page alone does not establish which explanation is correct.
known_findings.required_resolution: Confirm the exact file/version and inclusive data window against the authoritative deposited metadata or the dataset authors before any trend/window analysis. Preserve the response or immutable metadata snapshot.

known_findings.observation: The catalog maps code RV to the name Rietvlei, but the discovery catalog alone does not establish that this water body is the specific Rietvlei site intended for a Johannesburg-area study.
known_findings.required_resolution: Inspect the dataset's geographic coordinates or water-body polygon and match it to an authoritative site identity before assigning a city/region label.

candidates.title: South African river, dam and lake inorganic water chemistry dataset (1972–2011)
candidates.publisher: Water Research Observatory / Water SA; underlying data attributed to Department of Water Affairs and CSIR

temporal_coverage.basis: Dataset record metadata; confirm per file.

spatial_coverage.caveat: The catalogue describes more than 2,000 monitoring stations; do not infer every station has dense or continuous records.

reported_measures.name: Inorganic surface-water chemistry
reported_measures.method_summary: Record describes measured major ions, pH, conductivity, alkalinity and dissolved solids plus calculated variables.

reported_data_shape.access_note: The WRO page currently displays a 'Log in to download' message for resources.

license_assessment.displayed_access_status: WRO dataset page says 'No License Provided' in the top License section; an additional metadata field later claims 'Open (Creative commons)' with CC BY-SA 4.0 URL.
license_assessment.declared_file_license: CC BY-SA 4.0 is claimed in one metadata field but is not consistent with the page's top-level license state.
license_assessment.assessment_note: The conflicting license representations and login-gated downloads must be resolved against authoritative terms and actual files before use.

required_evidence: Written or authoritative record-level license confirmation resolves the conflict
Download/access terms reviewed; authorized access established
Original files and accompanying station/data dictionary artifacts retained with SHA-256 digests
Processing and exclusions of incomplete analyses documented from publication/source metadata
Measured and calculated variables distinguished before use

suitability.best_initial_use: Potential historical baseline after license and method reconciliation.
suitability.not_suitable_for: Treating it as raw unprocessed monitoring data without auditing its reported exclusion and derived-variable processing.
suitability.next_action: Resolve record-level license conflict and download terms; then compare data dictionary and published paper before selecting any series.

candidates.title: Department of Water and Sanitation water-quality monitoring portal
candidates.publisher: South African Department of Water and Sanitation

temporal_coverage.basis: Portal describes records as old as the 1950s at some sites; coverage must be checked per station.

spatial_coverage.caveat: Coverage is highly uneven; some groundwater sites have only one record and some river sites have thousands of samples.

reported_measures.name: Common water-quality constituents
reported_measures.method_summary: Portal provides site selection, tabular data and supporting plots.

license_assessment.displayed_access_status: Portal states data are supplied free of charge and may not be sold; use is restricted to academic, research or personal purposes.
license_assessment.declared_file_license: No general commercial reuse permission established by portal language.
license_assessment.assessment_note: Do not incorporate into a commercial service, resell, or redistribute under an assumed open-data license. Obtain explicit permission for any intended use beyond the portal's stated scope.

required_evidence: Explicit written permission covers the exact planned use and distribution model
Attribution language and any additional conditions recorded
Selected station's record continuity, units, detection limits and metadata inspected

suitability.best_initial_use: Potential academic, research or personal analysis within the portal's current terms.
suitability.not_suitable_for: Default source for a public or commercial Mycelix product without written permission.
suitability.next_action: Use only if the intended use fits current restrictions; otherwise prioritize a dataset with an unambiguous file-level license.
